title: Community Event Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:event
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for community event data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate community event events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how your community event activity added up each month instead of day by day.
